_why: Cloudflare Turnstile's SITE key. Public by design — it is rendered into the page and is meant to be seen. The matching SECRET key is never here and never in git: it is set with `npx wrangler pages secret put TURNSTILE_SECRET` and lives only in Cloudflare. If this value is empty the form switches itself off and says so, rather than rendering a box whose submissions the server will refuse.
_where: This sits under fy28/ because fy28/ IS the web app — src, public, functions, dist. The folder name is a fossil from when this site was one argument about the FY28 budget; it now holds every page, the archive and the API. The name is stale, the location is not.
